error.exception: RuntimeError: torch.nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy and torch.nn.BCELoss are unsafe to autocast
error.root_cause: The scientific objective consumes WSDDN bag probabilities, but both probability-space BCE calls execute inside torch.cuda.amp.autocast. PyTorch 2.10 deliberately rejects BCE under CUDA autocast because its backward gradient may not be representable in float16. Static CPU/synthetic tests did not exercise the complete objective under target-runtime CUDA autocast.
